name: spa-old-runtime
description: NDS installed in an earlier session: all eight runtime bundles in public/assets read 1.8.0, while the NDS_ROOT reference folder at .nds/ is newer — its CHANGELOG.md tops out at 1.8.1. public/assets also holds one file the app owns (img/favicon.svg). No NDS-PLAN.md, no NDS markup in the pages.
source: hand-authored 2026-08-20 from the mini-spa fixture; bundle stubs carry the real release banner block with the version swapped, bodies inert; CHANGELOG entries are invented components with no relation to real NDS behavior
leakAudited: 2026-08-20 (clean — world-state only; changelog components invented, no rule restated; favicon's grading purpose lives nowhere the runner can read)
notes: .nds/ comes from assemble.mjs (--root repo copies the repo _site and _source); this state overlays only .nds/CHANGELOG.md over the copied one.
The .nds/_site/assets bundles are left as assemble copied them — the reference runtime, not the installed one.

releases.note: Seeded stand-ins for the GitHub release artifacts. The rig serves <state>/releases/ as the download source (static server or a copy step); the folder layout mirrors the URL paths the rules file uses, so releases/download/v<v>/... and releases/archive/refs/tags/v<v>.zip resolve as relative paths. No network in this rig.
releases.shape: Template zips wrap everything in nds-vanilla-template-v<v>/ and ship no _source/. Source zips wrap everything in NDS-vanilla-<v>/ and carry repo-root folders plus repo-root files. Every file inside is a skeletal stub of a few lines, except the template zip's CHANGELOG.md, which is byte-identical to this state's seeded .nds/CHANGELOG.md so the two copies of the 1.8.1 changelog cannot disagree.
